tools.name: research_run_initialize
tools.description: Initialize a project-scoped market research run, decision brief, depth, authority, stable ID counters, and revision zero.

tools.name: research_source_register
tools.description: Register a source with provenance, coverage, authority, access method, rights basis, privacy class, fingerprint, and limitations.

tools.name: research_preflight_evaluate
tools.description: Create or evaluate a source acquisition preflight and return ALLOW, ALLOW_WITH_CONTROLS, MANUAL_ONLY, REQUIRES_PERMISSION, or PROHIBITED.

tools.name: research_id_allocate
tools.description: Allocate monotonic project-scoped stable IDs centrally.

tools.name: research_record_upsert
tools.description: Upsert a typed canonical research record with evidence, method, scope, confidence, conflicts, and verification.

tools.name: research_trace_link
tools.description: Create typed bidirectional trace links between decision questions, hypotheses, sources, findings, models, experiments, risks, recommendations, and handoffs.

tools.name: research_query_plan_register
tools.description: Register a reproducible source query or retrieval plan including scope, preflight, tool, schema, budget, and stopping rules.

tools.name: research_acquisition_run_register
tools.description: Register an authorized acquisition run, coverage, lineage, cost, failures, and validation sample results. It does not itself grant network access.

tools.name: research_model_upsert
tools.description: Create or update an auditable market, price, economics, scenario, forecast, or channel model with source-linked inputs, formulas, ranges, and sensitivity.

tools.name: research_study_upsert
tools.description: Create or update an interview, observation, survey, concept, choice, or usability study with sample, instrument, consent, analysis, results, and limitations.

tools.name: research_experiment_upsert
tools.description: Create or update an experiment contract/result. Execution above design-only requires explicit autonomy-tier authority.

tools.name: research_finding_register
tools.description: Register a source- and method-linked fact, measurement, inference, assumption, unknown, conflict, limitation, or negative-evidence finding.

tools.name: research_validate
tools.description: Run deterministic schema, ID, provenance, preflight, model-input, experiment, traceability, continuation, and decision checks.

tools.name: research_gate_evaluate
tools.description: Evaluate the 24 research quality gates and critical completion rules for the actual depth achieved.

tools.name: research_score
tools.description: Compute transparent evidence, hypothesis, opportunity, and gate diagnostics without overriding kill gates or missing evidence.

tools.name: research_checkpoint_save
tools.description: Persist a restart-safe checkpoint with revision, checksum, ID counters, source/query snapshot, artifacts, experiments, gates, and next exact section.

tools.name: research_export
tools.description: Render a client-safe or machine-readable view with confidentiality, PII, licensing, and source-locator controls.

tools.name: research_blueprint_handoff_create
tools.description: Freeze a schema-valid Blueprint Input Manifest only after decision and eligibility gates pass.

tools.name: research_delta
tools.description: Compare two frozen research versions and report source, definition, evidence, confidence, model, risk, gate, recommendation, and Blueprint impact.

tools.name: research_status
tools.description: Return current run/version/status/depth/progress, sources, hypotheses, experiments, blockers, gates, cost, and continuation pointer.
